evaluate_world_model_losses: use LossEvaluator to evaluate loss components including gmm, bce, and mse on a MemoryNetworkInput data page
evaluate_feature_importance: use FeatureImportanceEvaluator to calculate feature importance by masking each state or action feature to its median value and measuring loss increase
evaluate_feature_sensitivity: use FeatureSensitivityEvaluator to measure how much predicted next state features deviate when actions are randomly permuted across the batch
compute_median_feature_value: use compute_median_feature_value to calculate the median feature value for enum type or continuous features in a tensor
review_world_model_evaluator_classes: review the LossEvaluator, FeatureImportanceEvaluator, and FeatureSensitivityEvaluator classes for world model evaluation capabilities
